notes.title: The Boba Teashop is Out Now!
notes.notes:
🧋 The Boba Teashop is officially open for business!

Time to clock in, put on a smile, and start brewing. Customers are waiting… and so are the shadows lurking behind them.

I had a surreal time making The Boba Teashop. Even knowing how everything works behind the scenes, there are still moments during playtesting that send chills down my spines. The goal was to blend cozy shopkeeping with creeping psychological horror, and I'm proud of how it turned out.

If you’ve got feedbacks, bugs, or love letters to Risa, I’d love to hear from you in the Steam discussion tab

Thanks again for supporting The Boba Teashop. Now stop reading and get back behind the counter… that next order isn’t going to serve itself.

And remember... don’t look too long into the shadows.
